name: batchlight
description: A recall rehearsal and lot traceability workspace for small food makers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "PORT=3087 HOST=127.0.0.1 APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5180 tsx watch server/index.ts" "vite --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/precache.mjs && esbuild server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist-server/index.js
scripts.build:demo: tsc --noEmit && VITE_STATIC_DEMO=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/HACK47/ vite build && node scripts/precache.mjs dist /HACK47/
scripts.local: npm run build && concurrently -k "PORT=3087 HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=development APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5180 node dist-server/index.js" "vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort"
